nome_jp: 天頂開戦ゼニス (Tenchō Kaisen Zenith)
testo:
■ This spell cost 2 less to cast for each of your creatures that have both Unknown and Zenith races. They can't cost 0 or less.
■ Destroy all creatures except for Unknown.

■ アンノウン以外のクリーチャーをすべて破壊する。
